exact_parent_leaf_changes.before: And now come and see and understand: that after all the enormity of the multitude of covenants that every single person of Israel is obligated [to fulfill] for each and every commandment — even according to the one who says "surety of the surety" — even still, when one soul is drawn close to the holy gathering of twenty souls of Israel, the houses rise in multiples upon multiples, many times more than the entire enormous number of the multitude of covenants mentioned above! Look carefully and ponder [Editorial supplement: and you will find], according to what we wrote above — the number that emerges from the combinations made from thirteen souls — and then reckon fourteen times, then fifteen times, until the calculation reaches the number of combinations from twenty souls of Israel, which is a number of nineteen digits [Editorial supplement: tsifer], for the total is 2,432,902,005,471,040,000. Have you seen, my brother, how great and many the number of combinations from twenty souls is — multiples upon multiples of the number of the covenants mentioned above! And when one more soul is added to them — which then multiplies twenty-one times all the above — all the more so [Editorial supplement: and all the more so] — [Editorial supplement: one more and one more]! Stand trembling and astonished at how many thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads of houses are made from the combinations — what mouth cannot speak and heart cannot reckon — as is understood from the Book of Yetzirah regarding the combinations of letters.

exact_parent_leaf_changes.before: But according to the aforementioned calculation of the enormity of the number of the houses that are made through the gathering of Israel each time a neighbor is added — through this they will ascend to worlds many beyond number. Even though certainly in each and every world there are certainly thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads of houses — even still, the enormity of the number of the aforementioned houses through the aforementioned combinations, from one hundred souls, from a thousand, from more etc. etc., rises beyond fathoming and number, what mouth cannot speak and heart cannot reckon — until there will be made from them 310 worlds for each and every one, and in each and every world there will be thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads of myriads of houses. Set your heart well to all this and understand well, for the intelligent one can easily grasp it. And the essential thing is that you be in truth and temimus (sincere simplicity).

exact_parent_leaf_changes.before: And our teacher the rav Rabbi Nussun zecher tzaddik livrachah, upon hearing how he was revealing before him this matter that he had done from his own volition, [Editorial supplement: and what one merits through this,] and also from the greatness of his feeling of the pleasantness of these holy words — he became detached from his physicality and cried out aloud and said: "Gevald! Let me run in the marketplaces and streets and cry out: Ah! What are they thinking of themselves?" — and from the great conflagration of his heart, to the point that he literally departed from the bounds of the human, and he truly wanted to run and cry out as mentioned above. And immediately our master our teacher and our rabbi zecher tzaddik livrachah grabbed him by his garment and said to him: "Stand, for you will not accomplish at all." "Shtey du vest nit poylin."
